answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, rewards vest against future work. Each submission hangs on the zephyr of a task receipt, and the onyx is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
